answer: Validators lock 32 ETH as collateral on a knoll of quadratic staking where slashing penalties rise with the square of offending stake, imposing a super-linear capital barrier. A zero-knowledge verifiable delay function emits a deterministic pulse each epoch, forcing any Sybil set to spend compute proportional to the cube of its size so marginal attack cost scales O(n^3) while protocol revenue stays capped; at the nadir of expected utility the Nash equilibrium yields negative attack payoff, securing consensus.
